description: Start onboarding a user who does NOT yet have a Vorim API key (device-authorization flow). Returns a user_code and an activation URL. You MUST show the human the user_code and verification_uri VERBATIM and ask them to approve in their browser. Then call vorim_onboard_check with the returned device_code to obtain the API key. No VORIM_API_KEY is required for this tool.

client_name.description: Label shown to the human on the consent screen, e.g. your app or tool name

name: vorim_onboard_start
